# Type.ClosedRecord

```m
Type.ClosedRecord(type as type) as type
```

Returns a closed version of the given record type (or the same type, if it is already closed).

*Description: Microsoft, MIT ([THIRD_PARTY_NOTICES.md](../../../../THIRD_PARTY_NOTICES.md)).*
